title: A New First-Order Meta-Learning Algorithm with Convergence Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2409.03682v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning new tasks by leveraging prior experience is a fundamental trait of intelligent systems. While Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) is a leading approach, it suffers from significant computational and memory overhead due to the requirement of computing second-order meta-gradients. We propose \textbf{FO-B-MAML}, a novel first-order variant of MAML derived from a bi-level optimization perspective. Our framework introduces a new expression of the meta-gradient, defined as the derivative of the solution of a perturbed optimization problem. This formulation allows the meta-gradient to be estimated using various finite difference methods; in this work, we propose and analyze two simple yet effective estimators: a forward and a symmetric approximation.   Unlike existing first-order methods like FO-MAML and Reptile, which suffer from irreducible bias, we prove that FO-B-MAML converges to a stationary point of the meta-objective. Notab

translated_title: 一种具有收敛保证的新一阶元学习算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2409.03682v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：利用先前经验学习新任务是智能系统的基本特征。虽然模型无关元学习（MAML）是一种领先的方法，但由于需要计算二阶元梯度，它面临显著的计算和内存开销。我们提出了\textbf{FO-B-MAML}，一种从双层优化视角推导出的MAML新一阶变体。我们的框架引入了元梯度的新表达式，定义为扰动优化问题解的导数。这种表述允许使用各种有限差分方法估计元梯度；在本工作中，我们提出并分析了两种简单而有效的估计器：前向近似和对称近似。与现有的一阶方法（如FO-MAML和Reptile）相比，它们遭受不可减少的偏差，我们证明FO-B-MAML收敛到元目标的平稳点。值得注意的是，我们的方法在保持一阶效率的同时，实现了与MAML相当的收敛保证。
tldr: 提出一种新的一阶元学习算法FO-B-MAML，通过有限差分估计元梯度，在保持一阶计算效率的同时，实现了对元目标平稳点的收敛保证，解决了现有方法（如FO-MAML和Reptile）的不可减少偏差问题。
en_tdlr: We propose FO-B-MAML, a novel first-order meta-learning algorithm that estimates meta-gradients via finite difference methods, achieving convergence to stationary points of the meta-objective while maintaining first-order efficiency, overcoming the irreducible bias of existing methods like FO-MAML and Reptile.
